scope: Native RTOS synchronization, coherent RAM views, complete UI startup and virtual region installation

build.scope: GNU AM33-2 CPU core with offline GM5 execution harness

build_recipe_patches.purpose: BSD sed requires a separator before the closing command-group brace.
BSD sed requires a separator before the closing command-group brace.
Add short swap/swaph encodings listed in GNU's opcode table, using its existing long-form semantics.

build.instrumentation: GNU's instruction-prefix hook adds bounded stops/traces; generated CPU instruction semantics are unchanged.
build.license: GNU core and linked harness: GPL-3.0-or-later; GNU notices retained in source tree.
